TITLE: Used Diesel Fleet Vehicles: Check DPF and SCR Maintenance Evidence
PRIMARY_QUERY: used diesel truck DPF SCR maintenance records before purchase
SEARCH_INTENT: Assess aftertreatment maintenance evidence before accepting a used diesel fleet vehicle
BUYER_TASK: Decide whether records support purchase, require specialist inspection, or justify holding the offer
WHY_THIS_TOPIC: Specific aftertreatment evidence task, distinct from broad fleet procurement and general used-vehicle inspection
EXPECTED_DECISION: Accept evidence, request targeted investigation, or hold pending diagnosis
REFERENCE_MARKET: Manufacturer and US technical examples; not destination legal advice
FACT_BOUNDARY: Technical explanation and explicitly editorial evidence requests; no universal numeric criteria

FACTS.claim: Ash cannot be removed by regeneration; excess oil consumption can increase ash loading; manufacturer-approved cleaning and retained service records matter.
FACTS.scope: California retrofit truck DPF maintenance guidance

FACTS.claim: Backpressure varies with particulate accumulation and regeneration; regeneration frequency depends on duty cycle, filter technology and other factors; manufacturer device-specific instructions govern maintenance.
FACTS.scope: US historical retrofit DPF technical guidance, not current legal requirements

FACTS.claim: Cummins describes a restriction test after stationary regeneration when a DPF fault code is registered; no universal numerical threshold is supplied.
FACTS.scope: Cummins North American product and technical guidance

FACTS.claim: Particle contamination can damage DEF pumps and dosers; chemical contamination can damage SCR catalyst; concentration changes and dilution can impair aftertreatment performance.
FACTS.scope: Cummins SCR and DEF technical guidance

FACTS.claim: API recommends packaging and expiry checks, appropriate storage and dedicated dispensing equipment instead of equipment used for other fluids.
FACTS.scope: API DEF purchasing and handling recommendations

FACTS.claim: Published preventive maintenance includes DPF cleaning, DEF tank/filter work and dosage-valve cleaning; adaptive maintenance considers transport cycle and idle time. This is not universal coverage or a universal interval.
FACTS.scope: Volvo Trucks USA particular service offering

FACTS_ALLOWED_IN_BODY: Ash cannot be removed by regeneration; excess oil consumption can increase ash loading; manufacturer-approved cleaning and retained service records matter.

Backpressure varies with particulate accumulation and regeneration; regeneration frequency depends on duty cycle, filter technology and other factors; manufacturer device-specific instructions govern maintenance.
Cummins describes a restriction test after stationary regeneration when a DPF fault code is registered; no universal numerical threshold is supplied.
Particle contamination can damage DEF pumps and dosers; chemical contamination can damage SCR catalyst; concentration changes and dilution can impair aftertreatment performance.
API recommends packaging and expiry checks, appropriate storage and dedicated dispensing equipment instead of equipment used for other fluids.

Published preventive maintenance includes DPF cleaning, DEF tank/filter work and dosage-valve cleaning; adaptive maintenance considers transport cycle and idle time. This is not universal coverage or a universal interval.

Editorial recommendations: identify vehicle, engine and aftertreatment; reconcile dated records; request qualified inspection and vehicle-linked diagnostic interpretation; assess duty cycle and hold unexplained problems.
